purpose_zh: 把三处不可互换原型深化为可阻断、可拆除、可恢复验收的类型化装配关系；不把关系图写成工程设计或场地批准。
purpose_en: Deepen three non-interchangeable prototypes into stoppable, removable and restoration-reviewable typed assembly relations without presenting a relationship drawing as engineering design or site approval.

authority_boundary.rule: TYPE / DIMENSION / MATERIAL / CONNECTION / SPECIALIST CLEARANCE remain unknown until D01-D08 and H01-H07 close for the named place. A professional may revise, reject or delete the concept.

lifecycle_stages.decision: NO-GO unless every location-specific input is accepted
stay closed if any check or role is unknown
optional overlay remains off by default
no silent transfer to another place
professional reviewer may reject or delete concept

area_packs.name_zh: 众智园｜平行验证庭装配包
area_packs.composition_rule: parallel bands: continuous observation bypass / detachable isolation edge / bounded proof court / staffed takeover and recovery checkpoint
area_packs.non_copyable_reason: Equipment isolation, physical status and independent proof-court recovery answer a verification-site risk; they cannot substitute for resident consent space or a four-way commuter interface.
six_stage_journey: survey and locate only after D01-D03
verify bypass and physical stop before opening
keep proof layer off during ordinary use
remove equipment, edge, fixing and service traces

components.purpose: separate people and equipment without turning the ordinary bypass into a queue
components.ordinary_path_clearance: continuous bypass must remain outside the proof court
components.stop_trigger: boundary breach, collision risk, nuisance, unknown staffed takeover or maintenance conflict
components.removal_evidence: dated inventory of equipment, edge, fixing, cable and service traces
components.restoration_acceptance: path, surface, planting, sound/light and same-task service acceptance
components.forbidden_inference: not a certified barrier, railway/fire clearance, approved location or installed facility

components.name_zh: 实体状态与人工接管点
components.purpose: make stopped/isolated/manual status perceivable without a screen
components.ordinary_path_clearance: must sit on service edge, never inside ordinary bypass
components.stop_trigger: status mismatch, unavailable accountable staff or failed takeover
components.removal_evidence: status object, notice, temporary service element and log destination
components.restoration_acceptance: ordinary route and truthful status restored before any retest
components.forbidden_inference: not a confirmed staffed roster, emergency facility or operational SLA

components.purpose: hold reopening until place and ordinary service recover
components.ordinary_path_clearance: checkpoint cannot obstruct the route it checks
components.stop_trigger: missing removal evidence or incomplete surface/planting/service recovery
components.removal_evidence: closed finding list and component destinations
components.restoration_acceptance: independent acceptance with unresolved items visible
components.forbidden_inference: not a completed inspection, approval or guaranteed recovery duration

area_packs.name_zh: 原点社区｜一街两院四节点装配包
area_packs.name_en: Origin Community | one-street two-court four-node assembly pack
area_packs.composition_rule: one uninterrupted resident street with two side courts and four individually withdrawable screen-free nodes
area_packs.non_copyable_reason: Resident priority, screen-free learning, consent withdrawal and quiet closure require a daily-street/two-court sequence; they cannot be replaced by equipment isolation or commuter publication logic.
six_stage_journey: co-read existing daily life before locating anything
verify resident street, withdrawal and quiet controls
keep street complete with nodes optional
stop capture/matching/amplification and retain paper/manual task
remove kits, signs, capture, screens and traces
return street and courts to resident use and close consent records

components.purpose: support paper, conversation and manual learning without mandatory AI
components.ordinary_path_clearance: four nodes remain beside, not across, the daily street
components.stop_trigger: withdrawal, safeguarding gap, nuisance, disparity or quiet-gate failure
components.removal_evidence: node-by-node kit, sign, capture and temporary-fixing inventory
components.restoration_acceptance: resident street, seating, quiet and paper task restored
components.forbidden_inference: not resident consent, safeguarding approval, accessibility compliance or a confirmed programme

components.name_zh: 同意撤回与人工交接节点
components.purpose: allow a person to decline, withdraw or correct without account/QR/AI
components.ordinary_path_clearance: handoff must not gate passage or resident access
components.stop_trigger: withdrawal request, status mismatch, missing staff or rights concern
components.removal_evidence: withdrawal receipt destination and removal of capture/display traces
components.restoration_acceptance: same-task non-AI service and correction route remain usable
components.forbidden_inference: not a confirmed operator, legal consent finding or collected resident record

components.purpose: make optional activity yield to sleep, passage, caregiving and daily frontage
components.ordinary_path_clearance: no activity may occupy the continuous street
components.stop_trigger: quiet conflict, resident priority conflict or inability to remove amplification
components.removal_evidence: amplification, light, sign, queue and temporary-object exit evidence
components.restoration_acceptance: quiet condition and ordinary resident use independently co-checked
components.forbidden_inference: not a statutory noise/lighting conclusion, operating hour or resident approval

area_packs.name_zh: 大钟寺｜四象限步行与一厅一台装配包
area_packs.name_en: Dazhongsi | four-quadrant walking plus one-hall one-desk assembly pack
area_packs.composition_rule: four uninterrupted movement arms crossing at a clear centre; publication hall and dual-entry staffed desk occupy an off-route side bay
area_packs.non_copyable_reason: Peak commute continuity, source correction, dual-entry human service and quiet rest answer a four-way interchange condition; they cannot become a proof court or resident learning courts.
six_stage_journey: measure desire lines and peak conflict before location
verify four arms, clear centre and dual-entry service
keep commute continuous and publication optional
withdraw disputed publication and keep staffed correction/manual route
remove display, queue, light/sound and service overlays
restore movement, quiet rest and source-version trail

components.purpose: protect the ordinary movement denominator before publication or service
components.ordinary_path_clearance: all four arms and the centre remain clear

removable_interface_type.conceptual_relation: no component occupies the cross; only side-bay interfaces are removable

components.stop_trigger: peak-path intrusion, queue spill, source dispute, nuisance or inaccessible detour
components.restoration_acceptance: four-way movement and quiet-rest condition accepted
components.forbidden_inference: not a measured desire line, transport capacity, exact entrance or accessibility compliance

components.purpose: publish evidence with visible source/version/correction route
components.ordinary_path_clearance: hall overlay stays in side bay outside movement arms
components.stop_trigger: source challenge, stale version, rights concern or inability to correct
components.removal_evidence: display, sign, light/sound, queue and version-withdrawal record
components.restoration_acceptance: prior version remains addressable; ordinary movement restored
components.forbidden_inference: not an existing hall, cleared content, public endorsement or verified source outcome

components.purpose: serve both directions without forcing AI or reversing through the commuter line
components.ordinary_path_clearance: both entries open to a side bay and cannot gate the cross
components.stop_trigger: staff unavailable, queue spill, status mismatch or inaccessible approach
components.removal_evidence: desk, notice, queue element, account/data/log destination
components.restoration_acceptance: same-task manual service or truthful unavailability and movement restored
components.forbidden_inference: not a confirmed roster, service level, exact desk, fire egress or station approval

global_forbidden_inferences: relationship drawing is not an engineering detail
massing prototype is not an existing building
restoration checklist is not completed acceptance
PR review or merge does not authorize installation, trial, procurement, operation or maturity upgrade
